dataset.method: Code de la voirie routière art. L122-4 and décret n° 95-81; tariffs set yearly by the concession contracts, as published by each operator: their tariffs in force from 1 February 2024, as the Internet Archive kept them, for A'liénor, ALIAE, APRR, AREA, ASF, Escota. The other operators' documents of that year weren't archived, so their motorways aren't priced. ASF's archived 2024 grids (C3- and C4-TARIFS-WEB-2024) pair fewer stations than its 2023 guide; trips between stations they don't pair are priced only as far as published pairs go. A trip pays the published entry-exit prices along its route, excluding 20% VAT. Stations placed with the ministry's toll station dataset (data.gouv.fr) and OpenStreetMap.
